Base Threat: Sensitive data is compromised though attacks against SSL/TLS
Model Threat: TLS/HTTPS is enabled but not configured with modern best practices (e.g., weak ciphers still allowed, no HSTS, no certificate pinning on critical clients). Base Threat: Attackers could cause users to perform specific actions on their behalf through Cross Site Request Forgery attacks
